newsitem.title: POLAND: CLT-UFA TO START POLISH TV BROADCAST ON DEC 7.
newsitem.headline: CLT-UFA TO START POLISH TV BROADCAST ON DEC 7.

text.p: Luxembourg-based broadcaster CLT-UFA will start broadcasting its Polish-language TV station RTL 7 in Poland from December 7, CLT officials said on Thursday.
"The station will be launched on December 7 and the programme will be broadcast throught Eutelsat satellite from Luxembourg," Ferdinand Kayser, the head of CLT Multimedia, told a news conference.
Jerzy Hildebrandt, RTL7 General Manager, said that much of the programming would be produced in Poland.
"RTL7 is entering with a fully Polish offer, and not just translated programmes," he said.
RTL7 will be produced in Warsaw by a 50-strong team, made up 90 percent of Polish nationals, and will be broadcast via satellite from Luxembourg.
He said that a U.S. group might soon take a 50 percent stake in RTL7, which for now is a 100-pct CLT-UFA unit.

The company announced last month the merger of Luxembourg broadcaster Compagnie Luxembourgeoise de Telediffusion SA (CLT) with the television interests of German publisher Bertelsmann (UFA) would be finalised in the first half of January.
